title: Injury Engine
tagline: Every hit wounds a body part, from combat and falls to torture, and the wounds heal over time.
description:
Ships the LLM actions Torture_Target, Stop_Fighting, Stop_Fighting_by_Yielding and Start_Fighting (`actions/`), the truce and surrender decision prompts, and two prompts for injuries: a character-bio section describing what each wounded body part looks like, and a final-instructions section describing how it feels. Injuries (real damage: slashing, piercing, bludgeoning, burning, freezing, shocking, mauling, falling and generic; torture: whipping, pinching, slapping, pulling, punching, fire, frost and shock) are tracked per body part (face, back, arms, legs, optionally sexual parts) by `Injury_Engine.dll`, moving from light to severe damage, then through healing; the text comes from `SKSE/Plugins/Injury_Engine/injuries/*.json`. Requires `Injury_Engine.esp` and `Injury_Engine.dll`.

Plugin menu settings stay in `config/plugins/Injury_Engine/` (`injury_engine.*` keys). Hit narration and the action execution live in this mod's Papyrus scripts.
author: goodprovider
